sources.title: Ancient woodland, ancient trees and veteran trees: advice for making planning decisions
sources.verified_claim: Standing advice says ancient woodland and ancient/veteran trees are irreplaceable habitats and impacts should be avoided; inventories support screening but exact proposal effects must be assessed.

sources.title: Planning applications affecting trees and woodland
sources.verified_claim: Forestry Commission guidance explains planning and felling-control interactions and its consultation role for development affecting woodland, including ancient woodland.

sources.title: Ancient woodland Dataset
sources.verified_claim: Planning Data reports more than forty thousand ancient woodland geometries from Natural England and identifies the dataset as authoritative-source data.

sources.title: Ancient woodland status Dataset
sources.verified_claim: The status dataset distinguishes ancient semi-natural woodland and plantations on ancient woodland sites; status does not prove a sample candidate intersects one.

sources.title: Ancient Woodland (England)
sources.verified_claim: Natural England's England dataset maps ancient woodland and notes that revised county data takes precedence where available.

sources.title: Ancient Woodland - Revised (England) - Completed Counties
sources.verified_claim: The revised inventory improves boundaries, includes smaller ancient woodlands and wood pasture/parkland, and takes precedence in completed counties.

sources.title: Irreplaceable habitat
sources.verified_claim: DEFRA identifies ancient woodland and ancient/veteran trees among irreplaceable habitats and requires specific treatment under biodiversity net gain.

sources.title: Updates to planning guidance to help safeguard England’s protected species and ancient woodland, ancient and veteran trees
sources.verified_claim: Natural England explains that standing advice is intended to support planning authorities in assessing, avoiding, mitigating and, only as a last resort, compensating impacts.
